dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-gray geometries exhibiting high-contrast outer perimeters with a soft gradient transition from light exterior boundaries to darker interior centers, most prominent on the upper-mid dorsal and mid-lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of localized, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily concentrated as discrete point-features on the distal regions of the posterior flippers and scattered sparsely across the lower lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent 'O' shaped annuli on the mid-dorsal region form an obtuse scalene triangle, with the longest side extending longitudinally along the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: Distinct fan-like separation of the five digits on the posterior flippers, characterized by high-intensity specular highlights at the distal-most points of each digit.
